text: In Lawvere's structural set theory (ETCS), elements are not primitive: an element of a set $X$ is defined as a morphism $1\to X$ out of the ___ object $1$.
explanation: ETCS takes functions as primitive and derives elements as maps $1\to X$ from the terminal object $1$ (the one-element set). This structural viewpoint replaces the material membership relation $\in$ of ZFC.
